Developed by Aims Max Gardenia Developers Pvt. Ltd., the project houses over 900 apartments across 25 magnificent towers. Designed with a distinct 'golf-centric' lifestyle, nearly 80% of the project's layout is dedicated to beautifully manicured green expanses, water bodies, and outdoor activity courts. The project's location is a massive highlight, sitting just 500 meters from the Sector 50 Aqua Line Metro Station and directly across the newly opened Medanta Super-Speciality Hospital.
